data.title: Avive and Cambridge Fire Department Join Together for Community CPR/AED Training - Advancing Cambridge's Vision to Become a 4-Minute Community
data.description:
Avive and Cambridge Fire Department Join Together for Community CPR/AED Training - Advancing Cambridge's Vision to Become a 4-Minute Community

Avive and Cambridge Fire Department Join Together for Community CPR/AED Training - Advancing Cambridge's Vision to Become a 4-Minute Community

PR Newswire

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 15, 2026

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Avive Solutions, Inc. and the Cambridge, Massachusetts Fire Department are partnering to bring a CPR and AED (automated external defibrillator) training event to the Smith Campus Center in Harvard Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts on Thursday September 17, 2026, aiming to train members of the general public on lifesaving skills. The free event is a cornerstone of a broader, ongoing partnership between Avive and Cambridge Fire to build a 4 Minute Community™ - a program where trained volunteers can be dispatched with their Avive Connect AED® to a scene within the critical first four minutes of a cardiac emergency, closing the gap for when professional responders arrive.

 Avive and Cambridge Fire Department Join Together for Free Community CPR/AED Training - Thursday September 17

The free training will take place at the Smith Campus Center in Harvard Square, Cambridge in coordination with CrimsonEMS and ProEMS- extending the reach of Cambridge's community-wide preparedness efforts to one of the city's largest populations: students, visitors, faculty, and staff.

Event Details

  • What: Community CPR/AED Training Day
  • Where: Smith Campus Center, 1350 Massachusetts Ave, Cambridge, MA
  • When: Thursday September 17, 2026, starting at 10:00 a.m.
  • Who: general public, students, faculty, and staff
  • Training Equipment: 25 Avive Connect AEDs and CPR manikins, provided by Avive Solutions
  • Support: Cambridge Fire Department, CrimsonEMS, ProEMS

Why 4 Minutes Matters

The Avive 4 Minute Community Program is a groundbreaking initiative that transforms communities into proactive cardiac emergency response networks. By using historical sudden cardiac arrest data to strategically place Avive Connect AEDs with trained citizen volunteers - known as Cardiac Arrest Rapid Engagement (CARE) team members - the program creates a seamless bridge between bystander intervention and professional emergency response. The program has produced multiple lifesaving saves across the country and stands as a model for what's possible when a community decides that saving a life is everyone's responsibility.

A Community-Wide Strategy

Cambridge Fire Department's push to become a 4 Minute Community centers on training as many residents as possible, across workplaces, neighborhoods, schools, and now in partnership with Avive. With 50 Avive AEDs already deployed by Cambridge Fire and 326 more installed by MIT across its campus, nearly 380 connected devices are already in place citywide - putting these lifesaving tools within quick reach of students, faculty, staff, visitors, and the community's first responders alike. Expanding Avive's AED network further into the broader community would build on this foundation and reinforce the groundwork the city's universities have already laid. Training a population this large in a single day is designed to dramatically- and almost overnight - increase the number of prepared, potential responders across the city.

Avive Solutions is supplying 25 Avive AEDs and CPR manikins that make hands-on, simultaneous instruction possible for large groups of participants. The equipment lets participants practice recognizing cardiac arrest, beginning compressions, and operating an AED in a simulated emergency, rather than learning the steps only in theory.

Representatives from Cambridge Fire, CrimsonEMS and ProEMS will be on site throughout the event to support instruction and answer questions, reinforcing the coordination between campus responders and the city's fire and rescue services that a true 4 Minute Community depends on.

Looking Ahead

This training day is one piece of a larger, ongoing effort between Avive Solutions and Cambridge Fire Department to expand CPR and AED education throughout Cambridge - in schools, businesses, and public spaces - with the goal of making trained bystanders and ready AEDs a normal, expected part of everyday life in the city. Organizers say events like this one are meant to build momentum toward that citywide goal, not stand alone as a single day of training.

About Avive Solutions

Avive Solutions, Inc. is a Brisbane, CA-based company dedicated to developing state-of-the-art Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs) designed to be accessible, intuitive, and effective in saving lives during Sudden Cardiac Arrest emergencies. Avive's mission is to ensure that lifesaving AED technology is available in every community across the nation. Learn more at avive.life.

data.title: Allconnect™ Earns Its Highest ACSI® Score in Company History, Delivering Eight Straight Years of Industry-Leading Customer Experience
data.description:
Allconnect™ Earns Its Highest ACSI® Score in Company History, Delivering Eight Straight Years of Industry-Leading Customer Experience

Allconnect's has scored higher than or matched the top ACSI scores among publicly-reported companies every year since 2018, capped by a 2025 score of 89.

Allconnect, a leading consumer platform that helps millions of customers compare and connect services that run their homes, earned a 2025 American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI®) score of 89. This is the highest mark in the company's history and a higher score than of any of the more than 450 companies ACSI publicly reported across 43 industries in 2025.

The 89 caps an eight-year run in which Allconnect has scored higher or matched the highest ACSI score of any publicly reported company every year from 2018 through 2025. Allconnect's 89 came in above the score of every one of the 40-plus industries ACSI measured in 2025. The company's score is based on more than 100,000 surveys administered by Allconnect and modeled by ACSI LLC using its proprietary methodology. Allconnect's customers feel the way people feel about brands known for great service like Chick-fil-A, Apple, and Lexus: taken care of at a moment that matters.

“An 89 is the highest score we have ever earned, and it comes at a critical time when customer satisfaction has never been more paramount,” said Michael Doughty, President of Allconnect. “Maintaining our satisfaction leadership for eight straight years is a testament to how our team has designed every interaction and our technology around customer preferences.”

Allconnect credits the result to a consistent formula: delivering personalized and simple experiences across digital, voice, and agentic channels while giving people transparency, real choice, meaningful savings, and control over their privacy. That combination is what keeps customers feeling supported at high-stakes points in the home journey, such as moving into a new place or starting service.

“Allconnect keeps proving that a great customer experience is a real competitive advantage, not a slogan,” said Bill Mathauer, VP of Utility Partnerships for Allconnect. “These results reflect the work our teams do every day: making complicated decisions about the home simpler and earning trust one interaction at a time.”

For the utilities, retailers, and home services brands that power their customer journeys with Allconnect, the score carries weight beyond the recognition. Partners rely on Allconnect to handle the pivotal points in a customer's experience from Day 1 in a way that protects their brand, builds loyalty, and generates revenue. A leading ACSI score is evidence that the customers Allconnect serves are treated well, which strengthens the partner relationship at every step.

About Allconnect

Allconnect is a digital marketplace and customer acquisition platform that simplifies how consumers connect to essential home services through seamless voice, digital, and agentic

experiences. Since 1998, Allconnect has connected with more than 100 million consumers while helping leading brands, including utilities and communications providers, simplify complex decisions, acquire customers, improve engagement, and monetize high-intent audiences through performance-based solutions. Allconnect is a Red Ventures company. Learn more at https://www.allconnect.com/partner-with-us.

About Red Ventures

Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses, a joint venture in the health services industry, and strategic investments in Europe and Puerto Rico. Their businesses include The Points Guy, Lonely Planet, Bankrate, the Allconnect Platform, RV Home Client Growth, RV Growth & Transformation, Sage Home Loans Corporation, RV Education and more. Across the portfolio, Red Ventures businesses deliver seamless digital experiences for consumers, help Fortune 100 clients solve large-scale digital growth challenges, and create world-class experiences and opportunities for employees. Learn more at redventures.com and follow @RedVentures on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About ACSI

The American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI®) is a national economic indicator and a leading provider of customer analytics products that help organizations build lasting customer relationships and prove ROI on experience investments. ACSI’s AI-enhanced platform delivers intuitive dashboards and cause-and-effect analytics that pinpoint the quality drivers most predictive of customer allegiance, retention, price tolerance, and financial performance. ACSI data has been shown to correlate strongly with key micro and macroeconomic indicators, including consumer spending, GDP growth, earnings, and stock returns.

Founded in 1994 at the University of Michigan’s Ross School of Business, the ACSI measures customer satisfaction with more than 400 companies in over 40 industries, including federal government services, based on approximately 200,000 annual interviews. Learn more at https://www.theacsi.com.

ACSI and its logo are Registered Marks of American Customer Satisfaction Index LLC.

Surveys were administered by Allconnect and modeled by ACSI LLC using the proprietary ACSI methodology. ACSI LLC does not regulate the survey administration or sample size.

data.title: Massachusetts Senior Wealth Strategist Offers Complimentary Private Briefings for Retirees As Federal Debt Crisis Looms - This Education Focused Workshop Will Explore Strategies to Preserve Wealth as Federal Debt Surpasses $40 Trillion
data.description:
ROCKPORT, MA / ACCESS Newswire / September 15, 2026 / As federal debt surpassed $40 trillion in 2026, financial educator, wealth strategist and retirement income planner, Gary Cowles, is launching a series of complimentary public briefings. These are designed to help affluent retirees preserve their assets from what he calls "the six financial storms" threatening retirement sustainability (Source: U.S. Government Accountability Office (GAO), Report GAO-25-107138, November 7, 2024).

The educational sessions, titled "The Keys to Retiring On Your Terms," will be held in Danvers, MA with limited seating to ensure personalized attention. The briefings come at a critical time, as major provisions of the Big Beautiful Bill have introduced changes and federal fiscal pressures mount.

"With federal spending far exceeding revenue and top income earners paying substantial federal individual income taxes, successful retirees face a perfect storm of financial threats," said Cowles, founder of The Cowles Group. "These briefings will explore the risks posed by the "the six financial storms" and strategies to address."

Why These Briefings Matter Now

Several converging factors make 2026 a pivotal year for wealth preservation:

  • Federal interest payments exceeded $1 trillion in 2025 potentially impacting future tax policy
  • Healthcare costs continue to outpace inflation, with retirees now expected to spend $185,000 throughout retirement
  • Market volatility creates potential opportunities for strategic asset repositioning
  • For Massachusetts residents facing some of the nation's highest state tax rates and cost of living expenses, strategic wealth preservation has become essential

The Six Financial Storms Threatening Retirement Independence

Cowles identifies six critical challenges facing affluent retirees:

  1. Historic federal overspending
  2. Dangerous deficits and record debt
  3. Increasing taxes on the successful
  4. Persistent inflation
  5. Skyrocketing healthcare costs
  6. Stock market volatility

"According to recent surveys*, 82% of millionaires fear running out of money in retirement, and only 13% feel financially secure," Cowles noted. "This highlights the critical gap between wealth accumulation and effective wealth preservation."

What Attendees Will Discover

The briefings cover essential strategies including:

  • Ways to generate predictable and sustainable retirement income that is insulated from market and longevity risks
  • The "hidden death tax" on retirement accounts-and strategies to potentially reduce or avoid
  • How to potentially avoid or reduce capital gains tax on highly appreciated stock and real estate
  • Strategies to redirect estate taxes to charity instead of the IRS-creating a lasting legacy

"Most successful people excel at accumulating wealth but receive inadequate guidance on distributing, preserving and passing it on," Cowles explained. "The difference between traditional retirement planning and strategic wealth planning can mean millions of dollars staying with your family instead of going unnecessarily to the IRS."

Educational Mission Rooted in Personal Loss

Cowles' commitment to wealth planning education stems from a personal experience. When he was in college, his close friend's grandparents passed away unexpectedly and their estate paid nearly $2 million in unnecessary taxes. When he formed his own financial advisory practice, this enduring memory led him to focus on comprehensive wealth planning to ensure other families wouldn't face similar unnecessary loss.

"I spent many weekends at their Summer cottage, they treated me like I too was their grandson. They were a hard-working successful family, and they had an advisor," Cowles recalled. "But they never received comprehensive planning guidance. That preventable outcome-which occurred before I was qualified to help them - is a driver in my mission to educate families about both their lifetime and legacy options before it's too late."

The experience taught Cowles two critical lessons: failing to plan is planning to fail and timing matters.

"With over 2.4 million words in the tax code and constant changes, successful retirees need effective guidance," he emphasized. "it contains both landmines and gold mines. My goal is to help families avoid the former and capitalize on the latter."*

Target Audience and Registration

The briefings are specifically designed for successful business owners, executives and professionals who want to increase income while mitigating tax liability and are interested in potentially:

  • Using Roth Conversion to turn tax-deferred retirement accounts into tax-free income streams
  • Potentially eliminating hidden death taxes on retirement accounts
  • Potentially reducing capital gains taxes on highly appreciated assets
  • Seeking to create predictable retirement income that outpaces inflation
  • Protecting family wealth from litigation, divorce, and poor decision-making

"We focus on educating those who have been successful at building wealth but recognize they need specialized guidance to preserve and pass it on effectively," Cowles said.

Note: Traditional IRA account owners have considerations to make before performing a Roth IRA conversion. These primarily include income tax consequences on the converted amount in the year of conversion, withdrawal limitations from a Roth IRA, and income limitations for future contributions to a Roth IRA. In addition, if you are required to take a required minimum distribution (RMD) in the year you convert, you must do so before converting to a Roth IRA.

Limited Seating-Advanced Registration Required

Due to heightened interest and the personalized nature of the content, seating for each briefing is strictly limited to ensure attendees receive individual attention and can have specific questions addressed.

Seating is offered on a first-come, first-served basis and these briefings typically fill quickly. To reserve your seat, contact The Cowles Group:

  • Phone: (978) 999-5461
  • Website: www.the-cowles-group.com
  • Email: gary.cowles@the-cowles-group.com

About Gary M. Cowles, ChFC, CLU

Gary is a leading Financial Educator, Speaker and Wealth Strategist. As founder of The Cowles Group, Gary has spent more than three decades helping successful executives, professionals, business owners, and individuals navigating major life transitions (ie divorce or the loss of a loved one) preserve, and pass on their wealth with confidence and clarity. Gary's approach goes beyond traditional financial planning. He and his team deliver a comprehensive, personalized process designed to align every financial decision with the retirement and legacy each client actually wants - not the one they've been told to settle for. Gary received a BA in Mathematics from The University of New Hampshire and has earned both the Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC) and Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU) designations representing advanced expertise in tax, retirement, financial and wealth preservation planning from The American College of Financial Services - an accredited institution with roots in the University of Pennsylvania's internationally respected Wharton School of Business. Gary loves the beach, boating, running and sharing time with his family and friends.

data.title: SpaceX's Starship is finally set for orbit. A lot is riding on its success.
data.description:
By William Gavin

Next week, SpaceX plans for Starship to complete six orbits of the Earth during a nearly 10-hour flight

Starship, a massive rocket, is "core to the rest of our business," according to SpaceX's chief financial officer.

SpaceX on Tuesday announced a new date for its next test of the Starship megarocket, which it intends to finally send into Earth's orbit.

Getting the 407-foot-tall rocket into orbit would be a big accomplishment and would position SpaceX (SPCX) a bit closer to achieving a bevy of goals that rely on the vehicle's development. Prior tests have sent Starship only on "passively safe" suborbital paths, the company said.

The 14th Starship test is scheduled for as soon as Tuesday, Sept. 22, pending regulatory approval. It's the third mission involving the third version of the Starship rocket and its Super Heavy booster vehicle.

Starship is set to fly at an altitude of about 275 kilometers above Earth and complete six orbits around the planet. The mission is expected to last nearly 10 hours before Starship's planned splashdown in the Pacific Ocean, according to the company.

SpaceX said the mission would set up the "next phase" of making Starship fully reusable, which would help it keep costs down and allow it to increase its launch cadence. SpaceX has invested at least $15 billion in the vehicle and will spend at least another $100 billion developing a dedicated spaceport in Louisiana.

While that's a lot of cash to throw around, it also makes sense given the potential value of Starship, which SpaceX plans to use to launch Starlink and artificial-intelligence satellites into orbit. Whether an investment in SpaceX pays off "rests almost entirely" on the company making Starship fully reusable, Pivotal Research Group analyst Jeffrey Wlodarczak said in a recent client note.

SpaceX shares were down more than 2% in recent action on Tuesday.

The vehicle is "core to the rest of our business," SpaceX Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen said earlier this month. He also said next week's flight will be the first to generate revenue, since it will carry Starlink V3 satellites to orbit, something he called a "huge milestone."

SpaceX wants Starship to deploy 26 Starlink V3 spacecraft on the flight, each of which will add 1 terabits per second of capacity to the existing Starlink satellite-internet constellation. Together, that will add about 10 times the capacity of a single Falcon 9 launch of smaller satellites, according to the company.

Starlink V3 eventually "will deliver more than 100 times the bandwidth of our current 11,000 satellite constellation," Musk posted to X on Tuesday.

SpaceX has also said the primary goal for Starship's Super Heavy booster is to execute a successful launch, ascent and stage separation, followed by a boostback burn and landing burn in the Gulf of Mexico. The company said it had modified the vehicle's hardware to make its engines more reliable.

During the previous mission, SpaceX said the booster's three center engines showed signs of being clogged by ice, which prevented a successful boostback burn. That's a maneuver that positions the booster to return to a landing site.

The next flight will also be the last mission before SpaceX attempts to "catch the ship" for the first time, Musk said at the All-In Summit in Los Angeles on Monday. He added that he thinks it is "extremely likely that we will achieve full reusability with rapid reflight" in 2027.

-William Gavin

Investors have until November 10, 2026 to ask the Court to be appointed to lead the case. The complaint asserts securities fraud claims under Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 on behalf of investors in Lincoln securities. The class action is pending in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey. It is captioned Bacha v. Lincoln Educational Services Corporation, et al., No. 26-cv-11842.

Why is Lincoln Educational Services Being Sued for Securities Fraud?

Lincoln provides various career-oriented postsecondary education services to high school graduates and working adults in the United States.

According to the complaint, Lincoln told investors that its investments in people and processes were “positively impacting our student retention rate.” What’s more, Lincoln stated that its corporate partnerships and initiatives were “designed to begin yielding meaningful contributions as we turn into 2027.”

As alleged, Defendants failed to disclose that Lincoln’s admissions process was not effectively converting students from enrollment to start and that Lincoln was experiencing a significant drop in student starts relative to enrollment.

Why did Lincoln Educational Services’ Stock Drop?

On August 10, 2026, Lincoln reported earnings for the second quarter of 2026. Lincoln reported student starts increased only approximately 1%despite enrollment growing 9%, “as fewer enrolled students than expected attended the first day of class.” Lincoln further disclosed that “during the quarter, we observed changes in the student decision-making process that affected conversion from enrollment to start” and that Lincoln “ha[s] taken, and [will] continue to take, actions to address these trends[.]”

On this news, Lincoln stock dropped $10.22 per share, or 24.93%, from a closing price of $40.99 per share on August 7, 2026, to $30.77 per share on August 10, 2026, the following trading day.

data.title: PayrollOrg® Announces 2026 Prism Award Winners for Excellence in Payroll Operations
data.description:
PayrollOrg® Announces 2026 Prism Award Winners for Excellence in Payroll Operations

PayrollOrg® Announces 2026 Prism Award Winners for Excellence in Payroll Operations

PR Newswire

SAN ANTONIO, Sept. 15, 2026

SAN ANTONIO, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PayrollOrg, the leader in payroll education, publications, and training, today announced the recipients of its 2026 Prism Awards. The annual awards recognize organizations that demonstrate measurable improvements and best practices in payroll management, processes, technology, and overall operations.

The 2026 recipients are:

  • Overall Payroll Best Practices: Booz Allen Hamilton

  • Management: GCE Global Solutions

  • Processes: PagerDuty

  • Technology: Lithia & Driveway

  • Honorable Mention: TFI International

"Payroll teams are continually finding new ways to improve how they operate and better serve their organizations and employees," said Dan Maddux, executive director of PayrollOrg. "The 2026 Prism Award recipients demonstrate the measurable impact payroll can make through stronger processes, strategic use of technology, and collaboration across the organization."

This year's winners delivered significant improvements to their payroll operations:

  • Booz Allen Hamilton completed a 17-month overhaul of its payroll ecosystem, automating 98% of inbound and outbound payroll data and reducing its payroll processing cycle from five days to three. A shift from arrears-based pay also reduced overpayments by more than 60%, saving $700,000 annually.

  • GCE Global Solutions implemented a new global operating model that reduced internal payroll escalation cycles by 45%, payroll processing time by 40%, and operational overhead costs by 35%.

  • PagerDuty modernized payroll operations across five countries and reduced payroll processing hours per cycle by 45% and global vendor processing fees by 20%.

  • Lithia & Driveway automated its payroll reconciliation process, an initiative projected to eliminate 5,000 hours of manual work and save approximately $130,000 annually.

Presented annually by PayrollOrg's Strategic Payroll Leadership Task Force, the Prism Awards honor payroll departments that demonstrate excellence and innovation. Previous companies recognized with Prism awards include Palm Beach State College, Cloudera Inc., ArcBest, Banfield Pet Hospital, and Bridgestone Americas.

The 2026 recipients were recognized during PayrollOrg's Payroll Leaders Conference, sponsored by Corpay Prepaid, in San Antonio, Texas. For more information about the Prism Awards, visit PayrollOrg online.

About PayrollOrg

PayrollOrg® (PAYO) is the leading global authority in payroll education, publications, and professional development. Established in 1982 as the American Payroll Association, PAYO provides payroll professionals and organizations worldwide with trusted education, training, certifications, certificate programs, publications, and compliance resources. Through its global network and industry expertise, PAYO advances the payroll profession, supports career growth, and helps organizations navigate the evolving demands of payroll compliance and management.
